The '''Medal of Conspicuous Gallantry''' was an award given by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who distinguished themselves by serving above and beyond the call of duty. [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight Officer]] [[Sularus Brenn]], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] ace with 42 kills, was awarded this medal, decorated with [[Star/Legends|star]] clusters.
